scripts.bundle: read -p 'Enter bundle version, e.g. 22.22.22-work-conf-999: ' BUNDLE_VERSION && read -p 'Enter bundle out directory: ' BUNDLE_OUT && node ./tools/bundle.mjs $BUNDLE_VERSION $BUNDLE_OUT
scripts.download:sdk: node ./tools/download-sdk.mjs && npm run prepare:sdk && npm run absolute:sdk
scripts.compile: npm run compile --prefix external/compat && npm run compile --prefix external/common && npm run compile --prefix external/interop
scripts.release: npm run compile && npm run -C arkgen compile && npm run -C core compile && npm run -C linter compile && npm run -c arktscgen compile && npm run -C idlinter compile && node tools/release.mjs
scripts.sanity: npm run -C arkgen sanity && npm run -C linter run
